name: Dorian
source:
Unemotional, uncompromising, and intelligent enough to know when someone's trying to pull a fast one on him. Dorian is the ideal candidate to keep the unwanted out and the wanted in. Dorian loves friendship more than anything - more so than love itself. He feels that love can cause jealousy and create dangerous situations. Beneath Dorian's icy exterior, there are some mysterious hints at a rich inner life... Who on earth speaks nine languages aside from English, for example? Dorian exists in 17 different places around the house. Can you find all his different forms? ... Do you even want to?
Likes: Friendship
Dislikes: Nonsense

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
